title: Contents Packout & Storage — Contents Work Charged Above the Carrier's Approved Contents Scope
content:
On an insurance-funded Contents Packout & Storage job of Partial Contents Packout or Full Contents Packout, the carrier pays contents work only up to the contents scope it approved, and approves storage separately by date: **the contents work charged is every charge line on the job other than storage, declared-value coverage, card surcharge and late fee lines, and the approved contents scope is the total of the carrier's contents-coverage scope approvals on the linked claim file, and the most recent supplement request of a reason is the one of that reason carrying the highest supplement number on the file; when the claim file is in approved or settled status and the most recent contents added supplement request on its contents coverage is named by no carrier approval, the share carries the contents work charged less the approved contents scope less the amount that request asks for, never below zero; when the claim file is in approved or settled status, no such request awaits a decision and more days than the arrangement's supplement window have passed since the carrier's initial approval date, the share carries the contents work charged less the approved contents scope, never below zero; in every other case nothing is added.**

## Records read

- **Contents work charged:** the job's packing, cleaning, disposal, trip, report and move-back lines, that is every charge line other than storage, declared-value coverage, card surcharge and late fee lines.
- **From the Insurance Claim Services claim file linked to the job:** its status; the contents-coverage scope approvals (their total is the approved contents scope); the supplement requests on the contents coverage with reason contents added, by supplement number; whether any carrier approval names the most recent of them; the carrier's initial approval date; and the supplement window of the file's billing arrangement.

## Decision table

| Claim file status | Most recent contents added supplement request on the contents coverage | Days since the initial approval date | The share carries |
|---|---|---|---|
| approved or settled | named by no carrier approval | any | contents work charged less approved scope less the amount that request asks for, never below zero |
| approved or settled | none awaiting a decision | more than the arrangement's supplement window | contents work charged less approved scope, never below zero |
| approved or settled | none awaiting a decision | the window or fewer | nothing |
| any other status | any | any | nothing |

## Cases (hypothetical figures)

- Contents work charged 6,400.00, approved contents scope 5,000.00, an undecided contents added supplement asking 900.00: 6,400.00 less 5,000.00 less 900.00 is 500.00.
- Same job, the supplement decided, 75 days since initial approval under a hypothetical 60-day window: 1,400.00.
- Same job at 45 days under that window: nothing.
